name: Repetición de Píxeles en Video
description: Analyzes píxel pattern repetition in frame
algorithm: Pixel Repetition — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects pixel-level repetition patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **Espacial Repetition Detección**: The method searches for exact or near-exact pixel pattern repetitions within each frame. Copy-paste manipulation and some AI generators produce repeated pixel patterns (tiled textures from the generator's feature map).

2. **Generator Architecture Artefacto Detección**: GAN generators using transposed convolution upsampling can produce characteristic periodic pixel patterns ("checkerboard artifacts") at the generator's stride frequency. The method detects these periodic spatial repetitions in the frequency domain using spectral analysis.

3. **Temporal Píxel Repetition**: The method checks for repeated pixel patterns across frames — exact pixel-level repetition between non-adjacent frames indicates artificial frame generation or copying. Natural video never produces exact pixel-level repetition between distinct frames.

4. **Patch Similarity Análisis**: Local patches are compared using normalized cross-correlation. Unusually high similarity between distant patches (beyond what natural texture would produce) indicates AI generation where the generator's limited diversity manifests as repeated micro-patterns.

5. **Repetition - Scale Análisis**: Repetition is analyzed at multiple spatial scales. Natural textures can show repetition at macro scales (wallpaper, fabric patterns) but not at micro scales. AI-generated content may show micro-scale repetition invisible to human inspection but detectable statistically.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through píxel repetition analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
